dialogue.t: Oh? Are you looking for me?
...Hmph. What is it?

dialogue.sit: Attempt to make contact with her.

dialogue.t: We've got something to ask you...
Hmm? Who are you? Did that Mikawa Akane send you? Pfah. I just skipped a shift. You don't have to call people to catch me. Ugh!
Uh, you've got it wrong...
What, are you from the Tenryou Commission, then? I already told you. I was on duty that day, yes, but I've got nothing to do with that case of frostbite, you hear?
Uh, we're not from the Tenryou Commission either. We're...
What? So you're "fellow countrymen"? You should've just said so!
But you didn't let us speak earlier...
What? Are you trying to start a fight with me?
No, no, definitely not!
(Ugh, and here Paimon thought that Momoyo had a terrible temper. This Fatui lady might be even worse...!)
Hmph. "Fellow countrymen," eh? If you've got nothing else to do, get out of my way.
This job is tiring as all get-out, and there's not a moment of peace and quiet to be found. Archon, I might as well go "wash the dishes"!

dialogue.sit: Well, that might not be a bad thing.

dialogue.t: Huh? What did you say? If you've got nothing good to say, then get lost!
(Oh no, you misunderstood the meaning of that code word. She looks super angry right now!)
Get out of my face until you know what you're talking about!
(She seems pretty annoyed. We've gotta study those codes more carefully.)
Yes? What is it?
What—! You're... with the Shuumatsuban!?
That's right — and we're going to put an "end" to you!
So you are enemies. We must destroy the enemy. We must "clench our left hands"!
Wait. So you really *are* with Lyudochka, aren't you!?
Yup! That's exactly it!
Whatever! The way she keeps talking about other people just ticks Paimon off! Even Lyudochka wasn't this annoying!

dialogue.sit: May I ask who you are...?

dialogue.t: My name is Buzuleac, a merchant from Sumeru. I'm currently doing business in Ritou.
But I've been on break recently, so if you're here to talk business, could you come back in a few days?
Goodbye.
If so, or if not... what is it to you?
Either way, not your business.
Hmph.
What? Who died and made you the boss of me?
Hmph!
Come on, what was with that person just now? The road's wide enough. They didn't have to walk straight at us like that!
No "sorry" or "excuse Paimon" either. They just walked right off!

dialogue.sit: Things aren't quite that simple, Paimon.
I discovered this on my person.

dialogue.t: Eh? This is... a small note? You mean that person slipped it onto you?
Quick, let's open it and see what it says!

dialogue.sit: The note has an image of a shuriken on it.

dialogue.t: Huh, nothing to read over here. Just a windmill and a window.

dialogue.sit: I think it might be depicting some other things.
You mean a shuriken and a metal gate?

dialogue.t: Huh... You're right! Hmm, let Paimon think... A shuriken, huh... Ooh, that's right! It's the "Shuumatsuban"!
Paimon gets it now! This must be a coded message from Ms. Gendou. In that case, this "metal gate" has to be the entrance to her safehouse!
Come on, {NICKNAME}, let's head over to the safehouse. That's where Ms. Gendou's gotta be!
Well, look who's here. What? You've been staring since you came in.
Uh, Ms. Gendou, you look really different from before...
Did something change while we were out of contact? Don't worry, we'll do our best to help you out!
Changes? What are you talking about? Hmph. Forget worrying about me. You're the ones who were completely defenseless out there on the street.

dialogue.sit: Ah, this familiar, horrible tone of voice...

dialogue.t: Yup, that's the Gendou Ringo we know.
What are you two yammering about?
Oh, nothing, nothing! It's just good to see that you're well...
Hmph. For us ninja, every appearance is a disguise. I have a new mission now, so of course I no longer need that restrictive shrine maiden uniform.
Anyway, "Gendou Ringo" is still being used by that fake at the Grand Narukami Shrine, so use my new codename, "Momoyo." Got it?
Roger, Ms. Momoyo!
...Whatever. Now, back on topic. There is a reason why I haven't contacted you recently.
So what happened?
I guessed previously that the fake Gendou infiltrated the Shrine because she believed you to be Shuumatsuban members, and was thus preparing to infiltrate the Shuumatsuban itself.
Logically, she should be trying to contact you often, which will push the plan forward. But things have been oddly quiet there recently.
That's true. She hasn't given us any missions in quite a while.
Experience tells me that the Fatui must be "experiencing some changes" themselves. Perhaps they are planning to launch some truly large-scale operation...
That would be terrible!
That's why I looked for you today. I'm giving you a mission: figure out what the fake Gendou and the Fatui are plotting.

dialogue.sit: Should we actively seek her out?

dialogue.t: No need. Let's not stir them up just yet.
Recently, we discovered three other undercover Fatui. Disguise yourself as one of their comrades and try to coax some intel out of them.
Ehhh? That's a super hard mission! How could you talk about it in such a relaxed manner?
Oh, quit complaining. I've already figured it out for you. Here, take this code sheet.
That's right. The Fatui's modus operandi differs greatly depending on which Harbinger they're under. This latest batch uses codes to ascertain their common allegiance.
The codes they commonly use are written here. Take it.
That sounds super cool. Let Paimon see, let Paimon see!
Wow, so many of these words are more like scrawls, and there's water damage too. Paimon can barely read it!
Water? Huh, might've been saliva, then.
S—Saliva!?
Hmph. You'd best know that I somehow managed to snag that infiltration-specialist shortie to get this done. In fact, I'm impressed she actually managed to stay awake long enough to catch this much.

dialogue.sit: ...I think I know who you're talking about.

dialogue.t: Whatever the case, memorize those codes, and the rest is up to you. Adapt, improvise, and overcome!
One of your three targets is <color=#00E1FFFF>disguised as someone from Sumeru and often hangs around Ritou by the seaside</color>. Very easy to spot.
The other two operate in Inazuma City. <color=#00E1FFFF>One, a man, is dressed as a merchant. The other, a woman, started working in disguise at the Royal Hot Springs very recently</color>. Got that?
I'll be here in the safehouse for a few more days, preparing fake cadavers for a mission.
I've already marked the Fatui's locations out on the map. Go, and return quickly!
See you, then. If you wish to know more about Lyudochka, you can ask the others.
What, need more detailed information? <color=#00E1FFFF>One of those three Fatui is disguised as someone from Sumeru and often hangs around Ritou by the seaside</color>. Very easy to spot.
<color=#00E1FFFF>The other two operate in Inazuma City. One, a man, is dressed as a merchant. The other, a woman, works in disguise at the Royal Hot Springs</color>. Got that?
What are you standing around for? Cadavers aren't that interesting — or are you interested in being used as raw materials to make one?
Hello? Is something the matter?
Err, we're actually...
Hmm? Oh, I get it. You mean that you're also outlanders living in Ritou, right?
(Uh, so he seems friendly enough, but Paimon thinks you got that one a teensy bit wrong, {NICKNAME}.)
Sorry. Could you leave me alone for a while? I'd like to rest for a few days.
(Looks like he doesn't trust us. We should study the codes we were given one more time.)
Lyudochka must decide. Tonight.
See you.

dialogue.sit: Attempt to make contact with him.

dialogue.t: Wow, you're pretty easy to find, aren't you?
...What is it? You want to fight?
Oh, no, no, don't misunderstand. We've got something to ask you.
...Ask me? Who are you?
Actually, we're...
"Story?"
A man has no story. Only friends... or enemies.
(Wow. This guy's actually kinda cool... But come on, the code you gave was obviously wrong.)
...Hmph.
(Looks like he isn't bothering with us anymore. We've got to pay more attention to those codes.)
Alright, I'll rest up a bit further before going back to work. Working at a hot spring really makes you dizzy... That's how I let my Cryo abilities slip by mistake previously.
The Tenryou Commission hasn't stopped suspecting me over that, even now.
I took my eyes off her for a moment, and now she's gone...
Oh, my apologies. Do you need my help with something, by any chance?
Could we ask if you've hired a new employee recently? We'd just like to ask her a few things.
Oh, you must be referring to Tae. As it happens, I'm looking for her too.
She isn't very focused at work, and even skips out on her shift quite often. I bet she's hiding out somewhere right now, taking a break.
Somehow, there was an incident of a guest getting frostbite while she was on shift. So yes, she's a headache. In fact, I wonder if it might be better if she didn't come to work at all...
Um... Wow...
I don't think she'll have gone far. She should be slacking off in the courtyard by the cliff.
Well, you're finally back. Did you manage to get any intel from them?

dialogue.sit: You tell Momoyo the details of the intelligence you got from the Fatui.

dialogue.t: Hmph. Seriously, between the two of you talking over each other, your report was as clear as mud. But don't worry, I got the gist of it.
So, the fake at the shrine is named Lyudochka. Her superior has actually been pushing her to make further contact with you, but for some reason, she hasn't acted yet.
As such, this superior, whom they call "the Teacher," is going to give her a new assignment tonight. She will have to leave the shrine and go to Watatsumi Island.
That's exactly how it is, yes.
The details of this operation in Watatsumi Island is key intelligence. We must find some way to get our hands on it.
But we don't know where they're going to meet up...

dialogue.sit: We could follow her from the shrine.

dialogue.t: That is so. But given that the area near the Grand Narukami Shrine is filled with mountain paths, we're quite likely to lose her.
Wait just a moment.
Here. Use this.
Eh? Isn't this one of those Bamboo Slips you get from the Fortune Slip Box?
This is no ordinary Bamboo Slip. I've scattered some Shuumatsuban-made elemental powder on it. You can use Elemental Sight to see the traces left by the powder.
Oh, Paimon gets it now. We'll pretend to draw a Bamboo Slip, and then take the opportunity to get the powder onto her. Hehe, leave it to Paimon!
Stop waving that slip around! How are you supposed to identify the right target if that powder gets onto you as well, huh?
S—Sorry! Paimon's sorry!
Hmph. Anyway, this powder is somewhat toxic, so fiddle with it willy-nilly at your own risk.
(Y'know, {NICKNAME}, Momoyo seems really fierce, but she's actually a pretty nice person...)
Hey! Less jibber-jabber, more work! Any further delay and the sun's going to go down!
Alright, we're going, we're going!
